name: Gästehaus Gapp
beschreibung: The Gästehaus Gapp is located in the municipality of Wildermieming in the Tiroler Oberland. It is a traditional inn that offers a cozy atmosphere. Guests can expect warm hospitality and regional cuisine. Several hiking and cycling trails are located in the surrounding area. The rooms are functionally furnished and have modern amenities. An outdoor dining area invites you to linger in the summer months. The quiet location allows for relaxation in nature. Gästehaus Gapp is a suitable starting point for excursions into the Tiroler Bergwelt.
